updates.assessment: Saudi coalition confirms destruction of a Houthi missile fired toward Riyadh and says attacks on Bish, Farasan, Taif and Yanbu were foiled. Reuters-observed airport-area fire/smoke remains causally unresolved; do not equate it with a successful Houthi impact.

Mohsen Rezaei says Iran sent conditions to Washington via Qatar: end war on all fronts, release frozen Iranian assets/funds, end U.S. naval blockade. Awaiting U.S. response. Treat as Iranian stated position, not agreed terms.

White House confirms President Trump signed H.R. 5334, Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026, Sep 18. Supersedes prior 'passed Congress / awaiting presidential disposition' status.
Turkish FM Hakan Fidan says Turkey is ready to meet Saudi military/technical needs under Mecca Joint Defence Agreement. No Saudi request, deployment or transfer confirmed.
South Korea says it is willing to make a substantive contribution to restoring free Hormuz passage. No naval deployment or operational form established.
Russia and China vetoed extension of independent UN monitoring mandate for Iran sanctions. This creates/continues a monitoring gap; it does not remove underlying sanctions.
sources: Reuters Sep 17 UNSC Iran sanctions monitoring report
